content.title: Coachella 2026 Set Times Are Out: Here’s How to Watch Karol G From Home
content.text: Siddhartha is coming to the U.S. this summer! The Mexican singer-songwriter announced his upcoming Tú y Yo Y Tour today (Apr. 7), exclusively via Remezcla. The highly anticipated tour will kick off at the YouTube Theater in Los Angeles, CA, on Aug. 6, and wrap up at the Palladium Times Square in New York, NY, on Aug. 18. After starting off his tour in Los Angeles, the “Únicos” singer will continue to four more venues stateside. He will then perform at the Observatory San Diego in San Diego, CA, on Aug. 7; The Van Buren in Phoenix, AZ, on Aug. 9; and The Auditorium in Chicago, IL, on Aug. 16. His last tour date will be at the Palladium Times Square in New York, NY, on Aug. 18. Siddhartha is one of the most recognized names in Mexico’s indie and alternative pop scene. He is known for his popular hits like “00:00,” “Brújula,” “Ser Parte,” and “Abrázame,” which will most likely be on his tour’s setlist. The Tú y Yo Y Tour is described as “an intimate and immersive live experience, featuring both his latest releases and the songs that have defined his career,” per the press release. With that in mind, he will also perform his latest song, “Escápate Conmigo,” which he released on Mar. 24. Moreover, the five-city tour announcement comes after Siddhartha’s double performance at Tecate Pa’l Norte 2026, where he debuted his newest music live. He is expected to drop a new album later this year, following his previous LPs like Únicos (2016) and 00:00 (2022). The presale for Citi cardmembers for the Tú y Yo Y Tour will start on Apr. 7 at 2 p.m. local time. Additional presales will also be available before the general on-sale, which starts on Apr. 10 at 10 a.m. EST via Live Nation’s official website.
